references.text: The Lord sends more servants to the vineyard tenants, who are also mistreated, which parallels how God sent multiple prophets to Israel, but they too were mistreated or rejected.
This verse refers to how God repeatedly sent His servants, the prophets, to the people, but they were neither heard nor respected, paralleling how the owner of the vineyard sends more servants.
Jesus speaks of sending prophets and wise men to the people, who will be persecuted and killed, reflecting the action of sending multiple servants in the parable.
The parable of the wicked tenants in Luke's Gospel has parallels to the event in Matthew, where the owner sends several servants.
